verdict.rationale: Portkey's first-party load-balancing docs describe distributing traffic across multiple LLMs. Its gradual-migration and canary use cases, which send a small percentage of traffic to a new model, imply weight-based splitting. There is no evidence of latency- or cost-based balancing, and nothing explicit about balancing across keys or deployments. Missing for 10: explicit weight configuration documentation, latency-based routing, cost-based routing, key/deployment-level balancing, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can load-balance traffic across providers, deployments, or keys by weight, latency, or cost

citations.quote: Distribute traffic across multiple LLMs to prevent any single provider from becoming a bottleneck.
Test new models with small percentage before full rollout
Canary test new models in production
